title: The Township of Verified Error

features.name: town-hall
features.desc-on-touch: The building where beliefs were filed and catalogued. You can see the opinion shelves through the windows: carefully organized certainties, all of them wrong in the same direction.

features.name: monument-to-consensus
features.desc-on-touch: Erected when everyone agreed. They were all incorrect. The plaque has worn smooth, but the certainty in its every letter remains unchanged.

features.name: corrected-notice-board
features.desc-on-touch: Notices pinned explaining what the town got wrong. Layered: first belief, then correction, then correction of the correction. The layers keep growing.

features.name: archive-corner
features.desc-on-touch: Where the town keeps its old certainties, filed as 'historical misapprehensions.' The filing system assumes error will continue.

features.name: green-where-nothing-grew
features.desc-on-touch: The township believed trees would flourish here. They do not. The grass has learned to grow around the absence, and the townspeople have learned to believe in absence.

inscription: where opinion learned to set like copper oxides into certainty, and then began to discolour
